description: RecipeBee helps ChatGPT users preview complete recipes and meal plans, save them privately to a connected RecipeBee account, view saved recipes by ID, attach a conversation image, and explicitly request RecipeBee-generated images. Meal-plan imports check private recipe matches and let users choose whether to reuse each match or create a new recipe before saving.
